# `grouping_id`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

returns the level of grouping, equals to
`(grouping(c1) << (n-1)) + (grouping(c2) << (n-2)) + ... + grouping(cn)`

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
grouping_id([col1[, col2 ..]])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | - |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- grouping_id, example 1
> SELECT name, grouping_id(), sum(age), avg(height) FROM VALUES (2, 'Alice', 165), (5, 'Bob', 180) people(age, name, height) GROUP BY cube(name, height);
Alice | 0 | 2 | 165.0
Alice | 1 | 2 | 165.0
NULL | 2 | 2 | 165.0
NULL | 3 | 7 | 172.5
Bob | 0 | 5 | 180.0
Bob | 1 | 5 | 180.0
NULL | 2 | 5 | 180.0
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
